# Indexed small Lua GameDecal candidate (cloud source only)

Exact upstream parent: `0780bd7c530b0696067b717428b49a416eda556a` (R03).
The staging Git baseline only contains the exact touched R03 renderer file and is not a publishable descendant of R03. Apply the patch to the real pinned R03 parent. No main/release, remote branch, source coordinator, HQ, Mac, service, app, world content, GPU capture or benchmark was changed or run.

## Task list
- [x] Read the exact pinned R03 producer, renderer and MSL; identify the `DrawPreDecals` small Lua `GameDecal` branch.
- [x] Separate from original engine `GroundDecal` G01 indexed cube and copy-on-write dirty pages, previous SensorLOS R04, and full pending/queue changes.
- [x] Reconcile the original 42 estimate (strip-bounded deduplication) and 29 estimate (4 separated tiny vertices + 25 grid vertices with 102 indices). Select the exact dual-behavior 28 representative mapping with all original 96 slots, 32 primitives, order and winding.
- [x] Stage one opt-in C++/Objective-C++ candidate and portable implementation tests without editing the GLSL/MSL, game content or base app.
- [x] Run optimized warned-as-errors and AddressSanitizer/UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer CPU checks, diff checks, and verify the deliverable patch reproduces all three source files on the pinned original.
- [ ] Full macOS SDK compile and runtime proof the tested app entered the indexed path.
- [ ] Off/on same-row color, depth, stencil and coverage parity on Metal, then GPU timing if correct. No performance claim.

## Why this is separate
R03 `Metal4GameDecal.mm` emits a non-indexed 96-vertex triangle list per small Lua widget row. R03 `NativeGameDecalShaders.h` derives the position and UV from `vertex_id` and uses the same geometry shader substitute for regular 4×4 decals and for tiny two-triangle decals. Engine GroundDecal G01's indexed 36-slot cube and the engine paged-publication candidate do not touch this Lua consumer. PiP remains unchanged. SensorLOS R04 targeted different shaders and is not revived. R02 replay attribution can prioritize inspection but is not a frame allocation or expected gain.

## Behavior
`BAR_NATIVE_GAME_DECAL_INDEXED_GEOMETRY=1` selects the candidate at process startup; unset, zero, and all other values retain the original path. Only `NativeGameDecalProgram::Geometry` is affected. For each of its original 96 ordered slots, a representative original `vertex_id` is found by equality of the regular-grid location and the tiny-quad corner/clip-out sentinel. Every original triangle remains present under both branches. The template is **96 UInt16 indices (192 bytes), 28 unique original IDs**; the shader source, PSO, rendered rows, call order, uniform values, view/depth/blend/state and pipeline inputs are unchanged. In particular, the logical first row remains `u.options.z` and the logical count remains `instanceCount`; the index buffer offset is always zero and index count is 96. Large/extralarge real mesh paths are untouched.

The new index buffer is allocated once per device/resource epoch on the first affected draw, has a trace label, and stays immutable. Exact length, nonzero GPU address and two-byte address alignment are checked; its use is staged in `RuntimeLease::AddAllocation` each time, and each prepared packet has a strong reference. `ClearResources` drops the cache without altering lease, retirement, pending capacity, or queue policy. The candidate flags an invalid buffer rather than silently publishing timing for a fallback. See [Apple's MTL4 indexed instancing contract](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/metal/mtl4rendercommandencoder/drawindexedprimitives%28primitivetype%3Aindexcount%3Aindextype%3Aindexbuffer%3Aindexbufferlength%3Ainstancecount%3A%29?language=objc).

## Verified and not verified
The test compares the independent triangle-strip oracle, original shader's ID-only coordinate and clip logic, and the production mapping. It checks all 96×96 key pairs, ordered local/UV float32 bits for both size paths, clip-out, both size thresholds, alpha threshold and NaN branch semantics. A grid-only 25-ID negative control changes eight tiny shader slots. CPU verification does not execute MSL or prove raster results, GPU post-transform reuse or elapsed-time improvement. Indexed submission may itself cost more; any gain depends on actual small workload and cache. No quality option is reduced to make the benchmark pass.

Minimal later GPU validation: one combined candidate build; fix the first OFF/ON round to **AA OFF** and verify actual color/depth attachment sample count is 1 on each side. Verify the indexed-path buffer label and count 96, length 192, expected original row first/count, and no Metal validation errors. Prefer a local test fixture or replay where the *same* captured small rows and UBO inputs exercise tiny, regular, overlapping-blend, clip/reject and nonzero-first cases. Compare color, depth and stencil, and leave the flag off if not equivalent or not exercised. For timing, use matched same-native OFF/ON clean paired runs with capture/validation disabled; separately track actual vertex invocation counters for the small draw if available. The opt-in implementation can run at other sample counts, but MSAA parity and performance require separate tests. A new native/MVK3 capture pair is not required to evaluate this candidate; unmatched workloads are not a valid speed comparison. Explicitly report if SDK or hardware validation is outstanding.

Pinned upstream references: [renderer](https://github.com/yeojuny/BAR-Metal4/blob/0780bd7c530b0696067b717428b49a416eda556a/engine/rts/Rendering/Metal4/Metal4GameDecal.mm#L65-L75), [shader](https://github.com/yeojuny/BAR-Metal4/blob/0780bd7c530b0696067b717428b49a416eda556a/engine/rts/Rendering/Metal4/NativeGameDecalShaders.h#L69-L101).
CPU tests: g++ 14 release warnings-as-errors; ASan + UBSan, leak mode excluded under sandbox.
